independent_review.reasoning: CLM-R2-OB-CONTINUE-FEEDING exists to answer this instruction in bacterial mastitis, and CLM-R2-OB-MASTITIS-ANCHOR states bacterial mastitis as the segmental erythematous, oedematous, painful breast. The claim names the presentation, not merely the disease, so S-4 limb B is met on the claim's own words. Limb C holds: the competitor is correct only where a contraindication to the infant receiving the milk exists, which segmental erythema is not.
independent_review.scope_decision: Scoped to LD-OB54-03. It must not reach LD-OB54-02, where the same erythema is a key correctness condition of a different decision and an unscoped anchor would move an opportunity no reviewer considered -- the G2-PSY-04 leak, pointed at this study unit.

The claim exists because the presence of bacterial mastitis is the recognized reason clinicians reach for this instruction, and CLM-R2-OB-MASTITIS-ANCHOR states that mastitis as the segmental erythematous, oedematous, painful breast. It is the presentation feature this candidate shares with the key.
extensions.s4_limb_c: The candidate's correctness condition is that a contraindication to the infant receiving the milk is present. Segmental erythema is not that condition and does not appear in its tree, so the anchor makes the candidate live without making it correct.

independent_review.reasoning:
S-4 limb B is not met on a strict reading, and the strict reading is the one the registry adopted. CLM-R2-SURG-DRAINAGE and CLM-R2-SURG-STANDARD name appendicitis, the disease. They do not name migratory right lower quadrant pain, the feature. The wave admitted the anchor by substituting the vocabulary's statement of the disease for the claim's own words, which is an inference and not a citation.
The downstream evidence agrees and is why this is decided rather than argued. In the counterfactual run the three competitors this anchor served were live on it and on nothing else, and the post-stem coherence gate fired CS2-7 SET_LIVES_ON_ONE_FEATURE -- the set living on a single feature is exactly the degeneracy an anchor of this kind produces. The production gate refused all three under the pinned snapshot for the separate reason that the relation is not in it. UNCERTAIN fails closed.
independent_review.scope_decision: Would have been scoped to LD-GS76-03. Not activated.

review_protocol.independence_limit: A separate reasoning pass by the same model instance rather than a separate agent. It did have one thing the wave reviewer did not: the downstream result, including which sets the coherence gate refused. That is why it overturns three of the wave's own approvals rather than ratifying them.
review_protocol.standard: Design rule S-4 on a strict reading, plus the scope rule the registry milestone added: an approved anchor relation names the decision contexts its review considered and applies nowhere else. UNCERTAIN fails closed.
